query_summaries.description: This tool is designed to search a collection of documents to find information relevant to a given query, making it useful for retrieving specific data or insights from a large set of documents.
query_summaries.lesson: Good to do: Provide accurate and relevant search queries to retrieve specific data or insights from a large document set. Avoid: Using vague or unrelated search criteria that may yield irrelevant results.

query_summaries.description: This document search tool is designed to find and retrieve specific information from a collection of documents, making it useful when you need to locate particular data or insights within a large document set.

query_summaries.description: This tool is utilized to search through a vast collection of documents to uncover and retrieve information that is relevant to a specific query, proving to be particularly useful when the goal is to pinpoint and extract specific data or valuable insights from within an expansive set of documents.
query_summaries.lesson: Good to do: Formulate and provide search queries that are precise, relevant, and accurately reflect the information you are seeking to retrieve from the document collection. Avoid: Using search criteria that are vague, ambiguous, or unrelated to the desired information, as this may lead to the retrieval of irrelevant results and diminish the effectiveness of the search process.
